description: RealiTLScanner GUI (EikeiDev): Windows interface for XTLS RealiTLScanner with scan modes for an IP, range or domain, a file or a web page, a live log, a results table with copy and CSV export, and automatic GeoIP downloads. Runs the scanner from gesu/RealiTLScanner.
notes: Needs the .NET Desktop Runtime 10 or newer (or 9). If it is missing: scoop install extras/windowsdesktop-runtime-lts
The command realitlscanner-gui and the 'RealiTLScanner GUI' shortcut start it on the newest installed runtime, since .NET 9 is out of support.
The GUI runs the scanner from gesu/RealiTLScanner (instead of the 0.2.1 copy in the GUI's zip),
so 'scoop update RealiTLScanner' updates it for the GUI too.
Results: out.csv in the app folder, kept across updates (persist). Other relative names land in the
app folder of the current version and are lost on update: use a full path for those.
GeoIP: Country.mmdb in the app folder, copied from gesu/Loyalsoldier-GeoIP when installed; the GUI
itself downloads a new one from Loyalsoldier/geoip when it is older than 7 days.
pre_install: # out.csv is persisted; create it on the first install, or Scoop would persist a folder of that name.

script: # The GUI looks for RealiTLScanner-windows-64.exe next to itself. Replace the bundled 0.2.1 with a Scoop shim
# (Scoop's own shim.exe and a .shim file) that runs gesu/RealiTLScanner through its 'current' folder.
if (!(Test-Path $scanner)) { error "RealiTLScanner is not installed in this scope ($scanner): scoop install $(if ($global) { '-g ' })gesu/RealiTLScanner"; break }
if (!$shimExe -or !(Test-Path $shimExe)) { error "Scoop's shim.exe was not found ($shimExe)."; break }
# GeoIP: start with the database from gesu/Loyalsoldier-GeoIP if it is installed; the GUI refreshes it after 7 days.
# The shortcut opens this launcher, which lets the .NET 9 app run on a newer runtime.
':: RealiTLScanner GUI: starts the GUI on the newest installed .NET Desktop Runtime.',
':: The GUI is built for .NET 9, which is out of support since 10 November 2026;',
':: DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=LatestMajor applies to this start only, not to other .NET apps.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
